# The Practical AI Co.

> The Practical AI Co. builds done-for-you AI automation for small businesses — social content pipelines, product listing engines, and back-office follow-up systems — delivered working at fixed prices, with human approval on everything the automation sends or publishes. Based in Australia. We also publish free plain-English guides and a weekly newsletter teaching practical AI to non-technical professionals.

The Practical AI Co. is an Australian automation studio for small businesses: cafés, trades, boutiques, online sellers, solo operators and small teams. Every system we sell is one we first built and ran on our own businesses. No sales calls — projects start with one email describing the task the owner wants automated, and we reply with a fixed-price scope.

## Services

- [Content Autopilot](https://practicalaico.ai/#services): From A$990 setup + A$390/month. 8–12 branded social posts a week — researched, written, designed and scheduled to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or LinkedIn. The owner approves each week's content with one tap; nothing posts without approval.
- [Product Listing Engine](https://practicalaico.ai/#services): From A$690 per catalogue run. For Etsy, Shopify and print-on-demand sellers — turns a product list into finished listings (titles, tags, descriptions, mockup images) with an automated quality gate that reads every image and holds anything with a typo or print error. Printify integrated.
- [Back-Office Autopilot](https://practicalaico.ai/#services): From A$1,490 setup + A$490/month. Quote and invoice follow-ups, review responses and appointment reminders drafted automatically and queued for one-tap owner approval, plus a daily briefing of what needs attention.
- Custom builds: scoped at a fixed price from a plain-English description of the task.

## How It Works

1. Email the task you want automated (plain English, screenshots welcome) to hello@practicalai.co
2. We build the automation and demo it running on your real work before you pay the balance
3. The system runs on schedule with one-tap approvals; first month of monitoring and tuning included
